clue.text: Period desk, at rear, seen on standard film from 1990s

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece seen on another follows it, so the desk letter comes after the standard

parts.note: the Jurassic is a geological period
par is a standard or norm

indicators.note: at rear picks the final letter of desk

explanation.surface: A historian sits at the back of an office, watching a film about a past era from a standard viewpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: Spielberg's dinosaur blockbuster was released in 1993, so it is a film from that decade.

clue.text: Disrobe, turning red, sun beginning to scorch

indicators.note: turning means the letters of red and sun are churned into a new order
beginning to picks the opening letter of scorch

explanation.surface: Someone strips off as they redden in the sun, which is starting to burn.
explanation.definitionFit: To disrobe is to take off one's clothes, the verb sense of the same word.

clue.text: One caught friend under car flooring without thinking

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces placed under others come after them

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car
a mat is a piece of floor covering
I is the Roman numeral one
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone is caught with a friend beneath a car's floor mat, behaving thoughtlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something automatically means doing it by reflex, with no conscious deliberation.

clue.text: A few embracing British melancholy

indicators.note: embracing means the few holds the British letters inside it

parts.note: some means a few, a small number

explanation.surface: A handful of people hug a gloomy Briton.
explanation.definitionFit: Sombre describes a dark, gloomy mood, so it is a synonym of melancholy.

clue.text: Diana, a butcher, minced steak

indicators.note: minced means the letters of Diana a butcher are chopped up and rearranged, as meat is

explanation.surface: Diana, who works as a butcher, puts steak through the mincer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chateaubriand is a thick cut of fillet beef, a classic steak dish.

clue.text: Book of maps finally cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the phrase loses its final letter

parts.note: at last means finally

explanation.surface: A book of maps is at last trimmed down.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a bound collection of maps, so it is exactly a book of maps.

clue.text: Type of goat, latest of livestock, remains on edge when lifted

indicators.note: latest of picks the final letter of livestock

parts.note: ash is what remains after burning

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifted means the edge word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: A farmer describes a goat breed and the last of the herd's remains on a ledge being raised.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kashmir goat is the breed whose fine wool gives cashmere.

clue.text: Heard abject singing voice

indicators.note: Heard means the word for abject is said aloud and the answer is what is heard

parts.note: base means low and contemptible, abject

explanation.surface: Someone listens to a wretched, miserable singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bass is the lowest male singing voice in a choir.

clue.text: Check car temperature

parts.note: Audi is a German car make

explanation.surface: An instruction to read a car's temperature gauge.
explanation.definitionFit: An audit is an official inspection, a check of accounts or records.

clue.text: Son during lunch perhaps expresses hollow complaint

indicators.note: during means the son letter sits inside the meal

parts.note: lunch is an example of a meal

indicators.note: hollow means only the outer letters of expresses are kept, its middle emptied

explanation.surface: A son grumbles emptily over lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' here is an illness, not a grievance, which the surface hides.
explanation.definitionFit: Complaint can mean an ailment, and measles is a viral illness.

clue.text: Ship's guide going around in the morning

indicators.note: going around means the guide word surrounds the morning letters

parts.note: to steer is to guide
AM is the abbreviation for the morning hours

explanation.surface: A tour guide makes the rounds in the morning, as if aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive "Ship's" is the definition plus 's (is), a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamer is a vessel powered by steam, a steamship.

clue.text: Racecourse poems adapted

indicators.note: adapted means the letters of poems are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Verses are rewritten for a racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsom Downs in Surrey is the English racecourse that hosts the Derby.

clue.text: Fake selection of pedometers at zero

indicators.note: selection of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Bogus step counters have been reset to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Ersatz means an inferior imitation or substitute, so artificial and not genuine.

clue.text: English rogue involved in odd mistake

indicators.note: involved in means the rogue sits inside the odd word

parts.note: rum means odd or strange
a rat is a scoundrel, a rogue

explanation.surface: An English scoundrel is caught up in a strange blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: An erratum is an error in print or writing, a mistake listed for correction.

clue.text: American occupying kerb bothered street performer?

indicators.note: occupying means the American letters take up a place inside the shuffled kerb
bothered means the letters of kerb are disturbed into a new order

parts.note: US means American

explanation.surface: An American squats on a kerb, troubled by a street entertainer.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as a description rather than a synonym; a kerb is the edge of a pavement.
explanation.definitionFit: A busker plays music or performs in public streets for donations.

clue.text: Man on board to secure big gun

parts.note: the king is a chessman on the board
to pin is to fasten or secure

explanation.surface: A sailor aboard ship lashes down a large cannon.
explanation.definitionFit: Big gun is slang for an important person, and a kingpin is the key figure in a group.

clue.text: Hard to get Mark to join Anglicans

parts.note: a scar is a mark on the skin
CE is the Church of England, the Anglican church

explanation.surface: Mark is finding it difficult to be accepted into the Anglican church.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarce describes something in short supply, rare and difficult to obtain.

clue.text: Priest enthralled by Roman Catholic memorial

indicators.note: enthralled by means the priest is held within the Catholic letters

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Bible who raised Samuel

explanation.surface: A priest is captivated by a Catholic monument.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is something kept in remembrance of a saint or past event, serving as a memorial.

clue.text: Get to know meadow near rising

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the near letters are read upwards, reversed

explanation.surface: A walker explores a meadow close to a climb.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn is to come to know something through study or experience.

clue.text: I'm surprised one finally bought opulent headwear

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of bought

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in surprise after finally buying a lavish hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A coronet is a small crown worn by nobles, a rich jewelled head ornament.

clue.text: Blue-green beverage left

parts.note: tea is a beverage

explanation.surface: A cup of blue-green drink is left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Teal is a dark greenish-blue colour, named after the duck.

clue.text: Republican in retail redesigned advert

indicators.note: in means the Republican letter is placed inside the rearranged retail
redesigned means the letters of retail are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A Republican working in retail redesigns an advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer is a short preview that advertises a forthcoming film or programme.

clue.text: Greek character, railman, regularly skirts public house

indicators.note: skirts means the alternate letters go around the pub letters
regularly picks every other letter of railman

parts.note: PH is the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: A Greek railway worker walks round the edge of a pub on his regular route.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: At sea, my one line breaking off — the work of a shark?

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters of my one are mixed up

parts.note: ending means breaking off, bringing to a close

explanation.surface: An angler at sea loses a fish when the line snaps, perhaps to a shark.
explanation.walkthrough: The shark is a loan shark, a predatory lender, not the fish the sea surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan shark lends cash at extortionate interest, so lending is that predator's trade.
